things_to_avoid: Do NOT use sports team logos or Mardi Gras neon purple/green kitsch.
Do NOT retain 'Bloodhound' anywhere in titles, headers, alt text, meta tags, or user notifications.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown/header backgrounds.
Do NOT use generic blue SaaS gradients.
Do NOT break CSS variable names — preserve --bh-brass, --bh-paper, etc.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all user-visible instances of 'Bloodhound' are replaced with 'GEAUXleads'.
Update index.css with the exact hex values provided in colors section.
Ensure all interactive components retain or add data-testid attributes.
Verify dark/light contrasts fulfill WCAG AA guidelines.
